items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: The Government of Nepal has mobilized resources for search, rescue, relief, and recovery operations following the Bhote Koshi River floods on 26 August 2026, prioritizing missing persons including Nepali and foreign nationals. So far, 626 bodies have been recovered and about 2400 people remain unaccounted for, while over 4450 people including over 187 foreign nationals have been rescued from Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, and Chitwan districts. An Emergency Control Room has been established at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, with relief operations providing emergency medical care, food, water, shelter, and supplies.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area of Nepal on 26 August 2026. So far, 538 bodies have been recovered from the river areas, while out of 632 people from 33 countries, 121 have been found and 511 are still missing. Nepal’s security and disaster-management agencies are conducting search, rescue, evacuation and relief operations with full government mobilization.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue operations intensified Thursday at the mudslide-stricken Gyirong Port in Xizang, with 141 rescuers arriving that morning and additional teams, helicopters, and supplies dispatched to the China-Nepal border area. As of 8 a.m. Thursday, three people had been killed, 558 others remained missing, and two local villagers had been rescued. Priority efforts focus on addressing an upstream blockage before clearing debris, with drones used for assessment and relief supplies allocated by the Red Cross.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Severe flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River area of Nepal on 26 August 2026, causing loss of life, displacement, and damage to infrastructure. Nepal’s security and disaster-management agencies have been mobilised for search and rescue, evacuation, and relief, with 359 bodies recovered so far and 596 people from 33 countries reported missing. Further updates are available via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Emergency Control Room.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has established an Emergency Control Room to coordinate search, rescue, information verification, and consular assistance for foreign nationals affected by or missing in the Rasuwa flash flood. Families and concerned parties may contact the ECR via the hotlines +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 (7am–10pm) or official email channels. Updates will be published at https://mofa.gov.np/category/flashflood/.

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal on 26 August 2026, causing loss of life, displacement, and damage to homes, roads, bridges, and hydropower facilities. 72 bodies have been recovered so far, while 403 people from 25 countries (203 males and 200 females, including 62 Nepali nationals) are reported missing. Security agencies and authorities are conducting search, rescue, and relief operations.

items.title: NDRRMA rescue coordination portal
items.summary: NDRRMA publishes rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood on its official rescue portal and the SETU platform (setu.ndrrma.gov.np). Families should use these official channels for status rather than unofficial social media reposts. This site links to NDRRMA and does not copy individual case data.

items.title: Nepal Police official found and missing lists
items.summary: Nepal Police maintains the official Unified Database for missing persons, found persons, and unidentified remains related to the flood-affected areas. The lists are available to search at udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/missing and udb.nepalpolice.gov.np/found. Official confirmation of status comes only from Nepal Police.

items.title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
items.summary: The Embassy of India in Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa/Bhotekoshi area. Indian nationals and families may contact the MEA Special Control Room in Delhi at +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, or situationroom@mea.gov.in. The Embassy can also be reached via WhatsApp at +977-9851316807.
